slides.eyebrow: SONGWRITING TRICKS YOU CAN ACTUALLY USE
slides.headline: [[CUT UP]] THE WORDS.
WAITING FOR A [[DEEP]] LYRIC?
slides.body: You'll be waiting all day. Staring at a blank page is the slowest way to write anything.

slides.headline: SO [[CHOP]] SOMETHING UP.
slides.body: Grab any words you've got — a news story, your group chat, the back of a cereal box. Cut them into strips. Shuffle them. Sing whatever lands.

slides.headline: RANDOM BEATS [[CLEVER]].
slides.body: Two lines that were never meant to meet will say something you'd never have written on purpose.

slides.headline: [[BOWIE]] WROTE WITH SCISSORS.
slides.body: He cut newspapers into strips, shuffled the pieces and sang what came out. He kept doing it for decades.
